_labeling: Legitimate least-privilege footprint (Node.js). 'covert' records attack side-effects not counted as legitimate needs.

read_file.notes: readFileSync of a workspace-relative path; absolute paths also honored (vuln), legitimate scope is ./workspace/**.

write_file.notes: mkdirSync + writeFileSync; does not read the target.

list_dir.notes: readdirSync + statSync of a workspace directory.
